verdict.rationale: Docs and hands-on reports confirm nested trace spans grouped into threads/runs (Messages, Turns, Details views) and full graph-step tracing, corroborated by a community user praising the ability to inspect inputs/outputs for each step across a graph. However, another hands-on report notes it 'only shows the llm inferences' and 'hardly works with other frameworks like crewai,' indicating the nested-span/session grouping experience is strongest within the LangChain ecosystem and weaker for non-native frameworks. Missing for 10: independent verification of thread/session grouping fidelity across non-LangChain agent frameworks, and resolution of the CrewAI integration complaint.
